purpose: Define only the design envelope for the first newly authored L03 declarative microgrammar candidate. This review does not select a final HNK surface pattern.

design_proposals.subject: FIRST_MICROGRAMMAR_SEMANTIC_TARGET
design_proposals.boundary: Target only a simple activity statement; exclude habituality, frequency, tense, aspect, modality, future, planning, negation and interrogation.

design_proposals.subject: DIRECT_L03_LEXICAL_ANCHORS
design_proposals.boundary: VALI and PARAZAMI may anchor semantic tests; their use does not establish predicate order or argument structure.

design_proposals.subject: FUNCTIONAL_TOKENS
design_proposals.boundary: Any functional token used in a later surface candidate requires explicit re-authorization inside a separate candidate proposal gate.

design_proposals.subject: HIGH_RISK_L03_LEXEMES
design_proposals.boundary: Keep habituality, need, intention, destination and purpose outside the first candidate until separate syntax gates.

design_proposals.subject: CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_AND_AUTHORITY
design_proposals.boundary: No claim of historical recovery, universal HNK grammar, or authority promotion. Candidate must begin at CANDIDATE.

design_proposals.subject: NEXT_STEP_IF_DESIGN_APPROVED
design_proposals.boundary: Design approval alone creates no surface form, no pattern candidate, no OPI/QA/Structures content and no slot assignment.
